name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
November 13, 2007
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Pastor Jim Harper, Tri-City Church
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Presentation of Certificates of Appointment to incoming youth commissioners and Certificates of Appreciation to outgoing youth commissioners. (CC)
P2.
Proclamation declaring November 14, 2007, as "Allison Theoni Day" in the City of Vista. (CC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
P2.
Proclamation declaring November 14, 2007, as "Allison Theoni Day" in the City of Vista. (CC)
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Ordinances on Agenda (CC)
C3.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD/JPFA)
C4.
Notice of Completion for the Business Park Drive and San Marcos Boulevard Intersection Project (CC)
C5.
Notice of Completion for the Moonlight Amphitheatre Parking Lot Project (CC)
C6.
No Parking Zone on Townsite Drive (CC)
C7.
No Parking Zone on Alta Vista Drive (CC)
C8.
Safe Routes to Schools Grant Applications to Caltrans (CC)
C9.
Real Property Donation Agreement (CC)
C10.
Vista Historical Society Agreement (CC)
C11.
Vista Homeownership and Rehabilitation Programs (CDC)
C12.
Bicycle Transportation Master Plan Approval and Grant Time Extension Request (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , re-approving the Non-Motorized Transportation Facilities Master Plan; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , authorizing the Mayor to sign the Bicycle Transportation Account Cooperative Work Agreement form, requesting a time extension for the grant received from the California Department of Transportation Bicycle Transportation Account program for the design of the Inland Rail Trail.
C13.
Bargain Basement Stores in the Vista Redevelopment Project Area (CC)
ITEMS REMOVED FROM CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Fiscal Year 2007/2008 First Quarter Financial Report (CC)
1.
Receive the report; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , amending the Operating Budget for FY 2007/08; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , amending the Citywide Classification and Compensation Index.
PH1.
Calvary Chapel Church and School (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2007- , certifying the Final Environmental Impact Report prepared for Calvary Chapel Church and School, adopting the Environmental Findings pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act, adopting a Statement of Overriding Considerations, and adopting a Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving a Special Use Permit, Site Development Plan, and Tentative Parcel Map for a church and private school facility exceeding the 35 foot height limit, recreational fields, parking, and a separate industrial building on a 20.9 acre site at 1401 N. Melrose Drive.
PH2.
Financing for 2007 Community Projects (CC/CDC/JPFA)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2007- , making required findings authorizing the execution and delivery of documents relating to the sale and delivery of 2007 Certificates of Participation (2007 Community Projects) not to exceed $125,000,000 and authorizing certain documents and directing certain actions in connection therewith;
2.
Vista Joint Powers Financing Authority Resolution No. 2007- , approving a lease/purchase agreement with the City of Vista and certain other documents in connection with the execution and delivery of the 2007 Certificates of Participation (2007 Community Projects) in a principal amount not to exceed $125,000,000; and
3.
Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2007- , approving an amended reimbursement obligation related to Vista JPFA 1997 Lease Revenue Bonds and approving certain documents and authorizing certain actions in connection therewith.
PH3.
Adoption of Resolution of Necessity for 345 North Santa Fe Avenue (CDC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony;
2.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2007- , approving a Negative Declaration regarding the acquisition of the property;
3.
Adopt Community Development Commission Resolution No. 2007- , approving the Resolution of Necessity; (Recommended Action Continued on Following Page)
(Recommended Action Continued from Previous Page)
4.
Authorize the Executive Director to execute all necessary documents and agreements to effectuate the acquisition of the property; and
5.
Direct special counsel to proceed with litigation.
PH4.
Temporary Signs (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony regarding the proposed amendment to regulations; and
2.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2007- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Section 18.52 Relating to Signs."
PH5 Adoption of Building Codes (CC)
Recommended Action:
Recommended Action:*3
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony; and
2.
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2007-23, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Title 16 of the Vista Municipal Code Adopting by Reference Parts 1, through 6, 8, 10, and 12 of Title 24 of the California Code of Regulations."
PH6.
Adoption of Fire Code (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony; and
2.
Adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2007-22, entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Adopting the California Fire Code, 2007 Edition, the International Fire Code, 2006 Edition, and Appendices Chapter 1, Chapter 4, B, D, and F with Certain Amendments."
PH7.
Regional Transportation Improvement Plan (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2007- , approving the revision to the TransNet Local Streets and Roads Program of Projects for FY 2007/08 through FY 2010/11.
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies
ADJOURNMENT
